verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis for an enterprise customer-support AI platform, but the evidence never documents configurable retention periods, deletion workflows, or data-erasure controls. The only nearby items do not address the story: short-lived JWT tokens discarded after each session (decagon-docs-2) concern credential handling, and the vague 'data portability and control' line (decagon-docs-28) says nothing about retention or deletion.
